cohort: 338 pregnant women with SLE and 1014 pregnant women without SLE, from a tertiary medical centre in Shanghai, China, from September 2011 to May 2017
finding: Pregnant women with SLE had a significantly higher risk of pregnancy-induced hypertension, pre-eclampsia, premature rupture of membranes, fetal loss, preterm birth, intrauterine growth restriction, small for gestational age, caesarean section and neonatal intensive care unit admission, but a lower risk of gestational diabetes.
mod_finding: Pregnant women with SLE had a higher risk of caesarean section.
